title: Fresh object index can hide deleted object files
description: Evidence: packages/storage/src/object-store.ts serves listWorkItems from SQLite index when event-log head is fresh; tests/runtime/object-index.test.ts deletes a work object file and still expects the indexed item back. Doctor/search consume reader.listWorkItems. Impact: deleted object files can appear as phantom work in doctor/search/list output.
acceptanceCriteria: Object index freshness detects missing object files or verifies indexed rows against object presence, and tests no longer bless phantom deleted work.
